name: Repovive
long_description:
We work with AI labs to improve models on formal verification.

We have $100k in contracts across two math formalization RL environments and a $200k LOI for our broader coding data.

Our team includes IOI and ICPC medalists, PhDs, and ex-Google engineers. We’ve published papers at leading AI conferences, including NeurIPS, ICLR, and IJCAI.

We’ve formed the densest community cluster of 12,000 IMO, IOI, and ICPC medalists.
one_liner: Scaling AI formal verification for chips and critical software

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
CS PhD at UMD. National Informatics Olympiad gold medalist. Published papers at leading AI conferences, including NeurIPS and ICLR. Built math datasets with Lean-verified proofs for AI labs.

ICPC World Finalist, and ICPC North American Championship medalist. International Grandmaster on Codeforces, ranked among the top 200 worldwide (top 0.1%).

Built the Algorithms with Shayan YouTube channel with an IOI audience of 33,000 subscribers and 1M+ views.

founders.title: Founder/CPO
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder @ Repovive. Ex-Google and YouTube. Leading teams at Google Home (post-training Gemini for Home and Home experiences) and YouTube Shorts. MS in Human-Computer Interaction and BS in Computer Science from UT Austin.
